examples.claim: HF Transformers보다 최대 24배 높은 처리량, 모델 구조 변경 없이
examples.source: vLLM blog 2023-06-20: 'delivers up to 24x higher throughput than HuggingFace Transformers, without requiring any model architecture changes.'

examples.claim: KV 캐시 메모리의 20.4%~38.2%만 실제 토큰 상태 저장, 60%~80% 낭비
examples.source: arXiv 2309.06180 §3: 'only 20.4% - 38.2% of the KV cache memory is used to store the actual token states'; blog: 'existing systems waste 60% – 80% of memory'.

examples.claim: 빔 서치 예시: 블록 2, 4, 5, 8 해제, 9~12 새로 할당; 0,1,3 전부 공유, 6은 후보 0·1, 7은 후보 2·3
examples.source: arXiv §4.4: 'vLLM frees all physical blocks whose reference counts reach 0 (blocks 2, 4, 5, 8). Then, vLLM allocates new physical blocks (blocks 9-12) ... all candidates share blocks 0, 1, 3; candidates 0 and 1 share block 6, and candidates 2 and 3 ...'

examples.claim: v0.6.0이 ZeroMQ IPC 멀티프로세싱 API 서버 도입; V1은 격리된 EngineCore 루프
examples.source: V1 blog: 'In the v0.6.0 release, vLLM introduced a multiprocessing API server utilizing ZeroMQ for IPC ... creating an isolated EngineCore execution loop'.

examples.claim: 적중률 0%에서도 처리량 하락 1% 미만, V1에서 기본으로 켬; V0에서는 기본 꺼짐
examples.source: V1 blog: 'less than 1% decrease in throughput even when the cache hit rate is 0% ... we now enable prefix caching by default in V1'; 'it is disabled by default' (V0).
